description_en: Adds devices to the whitelist of a system version or application version by calling AddVersionWhiteDevices
description_zh: 调用AddVersionWhiteDevices添加系统版本或应用版本的设备白名单
kebab_example: aliyun iovcc add-version-white-devices --device-ids 11,22,33 --project-id P0VFCREU --version-type FOTA --device-id-type hardware_id --version-id 12345 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddVersionWhiteDevices

parameters.help_en: The list of device IDs, separated by commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 设备ID列表，英文逗号分割
parameters.name: device_ids

parameters.help_en:
The version type. Valid values:

FOTA: system upgrade.
APP: application upgrade
parameters.help_zh:
版本类型，支持：

FOTA：系统升级
APP：应用升级
parameters.name: version_type

parameters.help_en:
The device ID type. Valid values:

device_id: hardware ID.
sn: serial number.
vin: vehicle identification number.
hardware_id: hardware ID
parameters.help_zh:
设备ID类型，支持：

device_id：硬件ID
sn：序列号
vin：车架号
hardware_id：硬件ID
parameters.name: device_id_type
